approvedDesignFacts: Independent followup ROOT/private/state/approval prevent overwriting prior041 cutover history.
prepare locks current0b0 exact container ID and source-lock; switch rejects different ID and fixed-candidate mismatch.
Old and new runtime/Worker templates are byte-identical; rollback correctly starts local-candidate-worker.mjs with its matching pid path.
Candidate env removes old CANDIDATE_SOURCE_SHA before adding the fixed new one.
Candidate is immutable git archive; package and lock hashes must match old source before cached dependencies reuse; API and Worker verify all archive files before business imports.
Only publishing.ts and recovery.ts business files differ between0b0 and386b965; Store/schema and dependency manifests are unchanged.
Queued/running jobs, queued/running media and any delivery rows block initial switch; queue/media remain checked after pause and candidate startup.

Candidate starts API with outbound paused; schema compared before Worker; only ReleaseWorker and AlternateWorker loaded, local origin allowlist and delivery queue guard remain.

Rollback stops whole candidate even if pause CLI fails, starts exact preserved old ID, keeps DB and new rows, and only resumes local Worker if queues/media/delivery remain empty and prior pause wasfalse.

Recheck preserved OLD identity, current runtime/worker source hashes, queue/media/delivery state and single3457 owner immediately before mutation.
